Accepted heads to verify before runtime: AlembicCore 73cb9a340a4044eed68977d5ddbc36491deda674; Alembic 15ab82b0e3fd467a23999c3006cfb042618ba903; AlembicDashboard a1070f2ab52dbea06e94511892e2876074a2af9c. Objective: rerun the P4 final real-machine gate after the rescan job public evidence repair. Required gates: Gate 1 AlembicWorkspace: start/reuse real AlembicWorkspace daemon in production mode, no test AI fallback, ProjectScope five members; `/api/v1/panorama`, `/api/v1/panorama/health`, `/api/v1/panorama/gaps` return bounded successful responses; Dashboard `/panorama` renders overview/dependencies/graph/gaps; raw/UI evidence contains AlembicWorkspace members only and no BiliDili root/module/path/recipe terms. Gate 2 BiliDili: start/reuse real BiliDili projectRoot daemon; same three panorama endpoints + four tabs are successful for BiliDili single-project scope; raw/UI evidence has no AlembicWorkspace ProjectScope id/member roots/names. Gate 3 rescan: run one real scoped BiliDili rescan through `/api/v1/jobs/rescan` using the configured providers (DeepSeek generation, local Qwen embedding; do not change providers). Capture submit response, status polls, jobs/events, display-snapshot, daemon log excerpts, and final status. Because accepted Alembic repair exposes live process events and finalizes via `bootstrap:all-completed`, Test must inspect jobs/events/display-snapshot during the run, not only aggregate status counters. Terminal success should be `completed` with retained `finalSession.summary` or equivalent final job summary plus visible rescan process evidence; created/new recipe count is not itself the P4 criterion, so do not require `minNewRecipes=1` as a pass condition unless the API needs it for request shape. Use a terminal wait budget aligned with observed runtime stage budgets (analyze 480s, produce 900s plus buffer; do not reuse the earlier five-minute cap as a terminal-failure proof). If the job fails, cancels, remains non-terminal after that budget, has no post-session-linked process evidence, uses wrong root/provider, deletes snapshot tables, or requires full rebuild/preclean outside the tested data roots, return blocked with raw evidence. Constraints: Test must not edit source or commit; no push/tag/release/version bump; no checkout/worktree/branch/reset/rebase/cherry-pick; no deletion of `project_context_file_snapshots` or `bootstrap_snapshots`; no broad cleanup of real ~/.asd outside explicitly tested workspace data roots; no provider changes; no Test-created product fixes. Required evidence: command/runtime environment, accepted heads, raw summarized JSON for endpoints, screenshots/browser text for all four AlembicWorkspace tabs and BiliDili tabs, leakage check patterns/results, rescan submit/status/events/display-snapshot/final summary/log excerpts, explicit PASS/BLOCKED per gate, final product repo `git status --short` checks. Non-goals: do not implement fixes; do not perform P5 reference fidelity comparison; do not alter Dashboard/Core/Alembic source.
